posts.name: Estelindis
posts.cooked:
Craig:

 

Estelindis wrote:
I do wish my copy of Tactics from the Kickstarter had been shipped with my copy of Wrath too, but I'll happily accept what did arrive.  
Without looking, I'm guessing you didn't add on the extra shipping to have your Sentinel Tactics stuff shipped as it became available. Which means it will all come at once, when the maps are finished.

You're absolutely right: I did not add extra shipping so that the Tactics stuff would be sent as available.  I mean, if I had, you would've sent Tactics a long time ago, and not waited until now.  I just thought that, since you had to make two shipments anyway, one for Wrath and one for all my Tactics stuff, you might have felt like getting my copy of Tactics out of your warehouse as part of this first shipment and only having to ship the maps later in the second shipment.  I also thought that maybe you'd put my SS Tachyon promo in the same box as my Wrath stuff to save yourselves an envelope.  But obviously you know what the best configuration is for maximum shipping efficiency!  For all I know, it takes more effort to make these particular arrangements than it's worth, and it's far easier to simply put identical packages together in bulk  :)  Please don't get the impression that I'm not happy with what I've got.  I just have no experience in running a warehouse.
